posts.zh:
dsh-open-explorer 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 DSH 会话标题和工作区菜单中添加按钮，用系统文件管理器打开当前 Workspace 根目录。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2b9d61af060f2849ba2e.html
posts.en:
dsh-open-explorer is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Adds buttons to open the current DSH workspace root in the host file manager.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2b9d61af060f2849ba2e.html
